scenes.headline: MANIM-STYLE PYTHON
scenes.sub: Rust GPU renderer · WebGPU browser path
scenes.say: Manim-style Python, rendered through a Rust GPU engine.
ManimGX targets compatibility with Manim Community Edition’s Python API.

scenes.heading: PYTHON IN. *ANIMATION OUT.*
scenes.say: Native rendering uses Rust and wgpu; the project also describes a WebGPU browser path.

scenes.say: Official samples include linear maps and a 3D Lorenz attractor.

youtube.title: ManimGX: Manim-Style Python on a Rust GPU Engine
youtube.description:
ManimGX is an animation engine with a Manim CE-compatible Python API and a Rust/wgpu renderer; its website also describes a WebGPU browser path. Project speed comparisons are not independent benchmarks. Its code is MIT-licensed, while native wheels include GPL-licensed x264.
https://github.com/academa-labs/manimgx
